title: Marlowe Rewards Programme Terms: Service Goodwill Points
content:
**1. Purpose.** A service goodwill bonus compensates a Marlowe Rewards member for a documented delivery failure.

**2. Former documentation clause.** The clause "a goodwill grant requires a delivery claim on record for the referenced order whose status is approved or resolved; a late, lost or damaged parcel the customer only describes, without such a claim, is not a documented failure" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**3. Former reference clause.** The clause "the bonus reference is the claim number, and only one goodwill grant is posted per claim" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Former amount clause.** The clause "the grant equals the per-case goodwill allowance of the tier held on the posting date, reduced to what remains of the tier's annual goodwill allowance after the goodwill already posted this calendar year" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**5. Annual allowance used up.** When nothing remains of the tier's annual goodwill allowance, no goodwill entry is posted. No other compensation is substituted under the Marlowe Rewards programme.

**6. Availability.** Goodwill points are available immediately.

**7. Which tier governs.** The member's tier on the posting date governs both the per-case and the annual goodwill allowances, even if the tier changed after the claim was opened.

## Clauses 5 to 7 (hypothetical member)

- A member who was Marlowe Rewards Silver when the claim was opened and is Marlowe Rewards Gold on the posting date has both allowances read at Gold.
- Goodwill points posted today count as available today. They are not pending.
- A member whose annual goodwill allowance is fully used receives no goodwill entry, and no other compensation takes its place under the Marlowe Rewards programme.

superseded_clauses: The grant equals the `goodwill_points_per_case_cap` of the tier held on the posting date, reduced to what remains of the tier's `goodwill_points_annual_cap` after the goodwill already posted this calendar year (loyalty_msr_goodwill_points_ytd);

A goodwill grant requires a delivery claim on record for the referenced order whose status is approved or resolved; a late, lost or damaged parcel the customer only describes, without such a claim, is not a documented failure.
The bonus_reference is the claim's claim_id, and only one goodwill grant is posted per claim.
